text:
tess: short check 1 1 proposing pattern for left rail: canonical deep links via path segments, ephemeral UI state kept out of normal share URLs. sketch: https://figma.com/file/left-rail-share (frames). main goals: avoid surprise jumps, make copy-view explicit, and meet a11y needs.
omar: agree. prefer history.state for ephemeral toggles and use fragment only when user explicitly chooses 'Copy view'. keeps shared links clean.
rene: accessibility: when restoring a view that expands groups, fire an aria-live 'Navigation restored to X' and focus the primary item. ensure group toggles use aria-expanded and aria-controls.
sylvia: copy suggestions: button = "Copy view (include open sections)", toast = "Link copied 1 includes open sections". also show a dismissible banner when loading a fragment: "This link includes UI state".
tess: implementation notes: history.replaceState({open:['teams-42']}) for normal nav; when user copies, append a short fragment like #view=G:teams-42;projects-7 (encoded). sessionStorage fallback on full reload.
omar: dev ask: add utility to scrub sensitive ids when encoding fragment. also prefer base64 compression for long lists.
rene: add a11y test: keyboard-only toggle, focus after restore, screen reader announcement. I'll add to the accessibility checklist.
sylvia: minor: pin CTA label = "Pin section" tooltip = "Keep section open". keyboard: Space/Enter to toggle pin.
kb-bot: preview deployed: left-rail-share-preview -> staging at 2025-02-20T13:30Z :rocket:
tess: next steps: omar prototype encoder, rene write a11y tests, sylvia draft copy & banner. i'll update figma and post PR checklist here. thanks!
